thread:
jen: Morning folks, brand new SWE on infra team! Quick map request: who owns which "domains" for model serving incidents vs data/compliance incidents? Also who do I ask to get added to the dev GPU project and the compliance training checklist?

kevin: welcome :wave: TL;DR: eng-runtime = model process & runtime errors; eng-platform = deployment configs & rollout gates; eng-sre = infra (nodes, k8s, networking); eng-security = data/privacy/security incidents.

lia: adding process notes: if you see an error in logs that looks like a model crash -> page eng-runtime. If tokens spike or pipelines stall at infra layer -> page eng-sre. If you suspect PII leakage or data policy violation -> page eng-security immediately and don’t post payloads in public channels.

jen: got it. who signs off on dev-gpu access & PagerDuty?

people-ops-bot: Access flow for new hires: 1) manager approval via /access-request 2) people-ops reviews 3) infra grants project role. Link: https://redwood.internal/access-request. PagerDuty addition requires 1-2 weeks shadowing + manager confirmation.

kevin: note on ownership/contacts: eng-platform lead @lia handles rollout A/B gates; eng-runtime oncall is paged for process-level faults; eng-sre triages node-level incidents. For cross-domain incidents, page both eng-runtime and eng-sre and flag @kevin or @lia. For policy/compliance, always cc eng-security.

jen: where are the runbooks for first responders? I want to start shadowing ASAP.

lia: runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/inference/first-responders and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/platform/rollouts. There's a "new-hire oncall checklist" in the runbooks repo under /runbooks/oncall/new-hire-checklist.md.

infra-oncall: FYI: eng-sre oncall rota updates 2026-08-01. Check: https://redwood.internal/oncall-calendar

kevin: shadowing plan: 1) read checklist, 2) 1-2 shadow shifts with oncall mentor, 3) quick quiz with manager, 4) manager confirms -> people-ops adds to PagerDuty. Ping me once you finish step 2 and I'll connect you with a mentor.

jen: perfect. last Q: escalation timing thresholds? (when to escalate between teams)

lia: guideline: ack within 5m by primary oncall. If no ack -> escalate to secondary within 5-10m. If no progress in 15m or user impact growing -> call incident commander and exec oncall. Security incidents can short-circuit this timeline.

jen: thanks all, filling out the access form now and will DM @kevin when I'm ready to shadow. excited to be here! :tada:
